segments.title: Election Check-In: Jack Smith Filing, Trump-Pence Lunches, October Surprises
segments.notes: Case Blackwell and Jeff Ripple review the unsealed 165-page Jack Smith court filing on Trump's 2020 election interference, discuss Trump's 'so what' reaction to Pence's evacuation, private November 2020 lunches between Trump and Pence, and the broader October surprise landscape including Hurricane Helene, port strike, and Middle East escalation.

segments.title: TikTok Roundup: Home Depot Pranks, Jack in the Box, Eric Andre, Melania Trump, Summit1g, Kassem G, Triumph, Blastoise, Zheng Hu, Donkey Kong
segments.notes: Case, Jeff, and Sammy react to a cascade of viewer-submitted clips including a Home Depot lesbian stereotype video, aggressive Jack in the Box commercial parody, Eric Andre firing/hiring bit, Melania Trump's 'individual freedom' video, Summit1g's Simon Says streamers, Kassem G's 'pastum' era, a Trump supporter yelling 'Fire AOC', Triumph the Insult Comic Dog at the VP debate, Wu Tang kids, police de-escalation on a roof, a plant-assault video, Blastoise with Sopranos energy, a medieval maiden/Zheng Hu animation, Canadian 'yeah no' linguistics, and a Donkey Kong vs Bowser Melee clip.

segments.title: Rennerton Mayoral Nominations — Round 1
segments.notes: Flash poll opens for the first of four mayoral candidate slots ahead of the Rennerton return stream; chat nominates Peter Gibbon, Jeb, Mancini Smooth, Pepito, and dark-horse Jolly Jim; Pepito declares immediate victory and threatens FEMA/SPCA litigation.

segments.title: Bigfoot Sighting in Oklahoma & Gorilla Penis Science
segments.notes: Guy Redacted debuts to analyze a clear Bigfoot face capture from Parallel Forest, Lawton, OK; claims Bigfoot eats his free-range dogs and leaves thank-you notes; Chet and ChetAI commandeer the broadcast after the word 'science' is spoken, delivering a peer-reviewed breakdown of gorilla genitalia (1.1 inches, smallest relative to body mass of any mammal) and the evolutionary trade-off between harem defense and sperm competition.

segments.title: Rennerton Mayoral Nominations — Round 2
segments.notes: Second flash poll yields nominees Peter, Crumb, September Tyler, and Steve Seven Bows (Sammy Seven Elbows); September Tyler takes an early lead.

segments.title: Hamburger Interview: Burglar Rapper Steals Burritos
segments.notes: The Hamburger — a one-toothed, SoundCloud-aspiring burglar — crashes the studio, raps about hopping fences and stealing burritos from farmers' fences, confirms Pepito's burrito-theft allegations, then exits before a proper interview can conclude.

segments.title: House Move Update: LA County Permit Purgatory
segments.notes: Case details the multi-month hold on his new home built by Kendall's parents; a single LA county department with no phone, no office, and a four-week email reply cycle has stalled occupancy since December; Case characterizes it as underfunded, semi-grifty red tape rather than safety regulation.

segments.title: Gen Z Gaming Celebrity Brainstorm for Kendall
segments.notes: Chat and studio toss names for a Gen Z–targeted gaming event: T-Pain, Jack Black, Austin Creed, W2S, Matthew Mercer, Greg Miller, Todd Stashwick, Tom Holland, Skibidi Toilet, Felicia Day, Jeff Gerstmann, Tony Hawk, Devin Pantera, Henry Cavill, AOC, Hasan, Valkyrae, Sykkuno, Disguised Toast, VTubers, Randy Orton, Snoop Dogg, Seth Rogen, Ice-T, Elon Musk, Zachary Levi, Samuel L. Jackson, Michelle Rodriguez, Drake; Case and Jeff debate the futility of intentional generational marketing.

segments.title: AEW Signs Multi-Year Max Streaming Deal with Warner Bros. Discovery
segments.notes: Case covers the ~$150M deal keeping Dynamite and Collision on TBS/TNT while adding live simulcast on Max and on-demand from January 2025; Garf (Gruff) interrupts with an improvised folk song, briefly breaking Pepito's switchboard; enhanced social media rights and discounted PPVs on Max also noted.

segments.title: Park Ranger Runs for Mayor, Shaved Bigfoot Sings, Hamster Seeks Hospice, Tony Khan Offers $3M Then Fires Trip
segments.notes: Trip Bradstein fields park denizens: a Park Ranger announces Rennerton mayoral bid; a fully shaved Bigfoot auditions as a lounge singer; a two-year-lifespan hamster requests a bush to die in (with workout bike and blow-up pool); a W-star Rip Blazer from the future seeks a tag partner for pizza-oven control; Bob the Bush confesses to watching Trip urinate; Tony Khan appears, offers Trip $3M to join AEW, then fires him moments later for 'aggressive energy' from a bystander.

segments.title: Rennerton Mayoral Nominations — Final Round
segments.notes: Fourth and final flash poll: Jeb & Wooddad (VP ticket), Crumb, Munch, Hype Train, and Shaved Bigfoot Fun Time Jamboree; Hype Train edges a photo finish to claim the last ballot slot alongside September Tyler, Lady Kendall, and Pepito.

segments.title: Sign-Off: Pepito Appoints Pepe Dois to Guard Gold, Pretorian Guard Raids Sponacci
segments.notes: Pepito announces the appointment of Pepe Dois to replace Fort Knox as national gold repository; the Pretorian Guard arrives, quizzes Case on Age of Empires, deems him unready, and executes a raid to Sponacci's channel.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News opened with a deep dive into the unsealed Jack Smith filing on Trump's 2020 election interference, then pivoted to a sprawling Amongst the Web TikTok review. Guy Redacted surfaced to authenticate an Oklahoma Bigfoot video, triggering a Chet Guy the Science Eyes takeover on gorilla reproductive biology. Three Rennerton mayoral nomination polls filled the ballot with September Tyler, Lady Kendall, Pepito, and Hype Train. Trip Bradstein's park beat yielded a shaved Bigfoot lounge singer, a dying hamster roommate seeker, and a hire-then-fire encounter with Tony Khan. The broadcast closed with Pepito appointing Pepe Dois to guard the national gold and the Pretorian Guard raiding Sponacci.
